title: SourceOutput
description: `source` role output (§13). The model sees the notes as [n]-numbered sentences (server split, §15) and returns only edits; the server applies them, so sentences it does not name stay byte-identical. Changed sentences are the edited and added ones.

edits.description: Existing sentences this turn changes: text replaces sentence [index], null deletes it. The server drops out-of-range and repeated indexes.

added.description: New sentences appended after the notes, in order.

questions.description: Follow-up questions for missing or ambiguous information.

similar_names.description: Pairs of names that may be one entity spelled differently (레오/래오), within the notes or against existing cards.

card_id.description: Existing card named similar_to, or null if it is only in the notes.
